title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Cannot modify thinking blocks in assistant messages
body:
**Bug Description**
API Error: 400 messages.1.content.56: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must
     remain as they were in the original response

Dup of https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/12311

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: ghostty
- Version: 2.1.153
- Feedback ID: ac8742c0-36c5-484d-8067-90e42143ddfd

top_comments.body:
Also hitting this today on the Claude desktop app. Same error:
API Error: 400 messages.X.content.Y: thinking or redacted_thinking blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must remain as they were in the original response.
Environment:

Platform:  macOS 
App version: latest
Model: Opus 4.7 and 4.8

Repro: long conversation
The conversation becomes unrecoverable after this — have to start a new session to continue.
